name: death-front
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. FRONT-facing DEATH/CORPSE sequence, exactly FOUR COMPLETE poses in a 2x2 SQUARE grid, preferably 1536x1536. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. View stays in front of zombie throughout, both eyes/chest face viewer when upright. Frame 1: upright zombie reels with knees starting to buckle, head/torso visible, standing anatomical head-to-sole height about 450px. Frame 2: knees collapse into a low kneeling slump, arms sag. Frame 3: body falls onto side on the ground, head toward LEFT and shoes toward RIGHT, torso/head near floor. Frame 4: final motionless corpse lies flat across ground with same head-left/shoes-right direction, arms limp and legs extended. Preserve SAME anatomical size/limb lengths across all four; falling and flat poses become LOWER and WIDER, NEVER rescale flat corpse to standing height. Entire body including hands/boots inside its own cell. Corpse length up to 560px with very wide transparent gutters and margins. No ghost/resurrection, no blood pool, no effects, no floor. Upper figures must end above the horizontal halfway line, lower figures entirely below it.
